tagline.id: Sel filtrasi membran stainless bertekanan gas untuk uji skala lab.
tagline.en: A gas-pressurized stainless steel membrane filtration cell for lab-scale testing.

approach.id: Chamber stainless dengan gasket PTFE, membran, dan penampung permeat. Tekanan diberikan dari tabung gas, diatur needle valve dan dibaca pressure gauge ½" NPT, dan selnya diletakkan di atas hot plate.
approach.en: A stainless steel chamber with a PTFE gasket, membrane, and permeate collector. Pressure comes from a gas bottle, set with a needle valve and read on a ½" NPT pressure gauge, and the cell sits on a hot plate.
